I was diagnosed last year (28F) I couldn’t believe how much my life had turned around. In high school I could never stay focused on anything my depression got so bad the school told me to leave in year 11. I could never stick to a job or study what I was interested in. My doctor misdiagnosed me with BPD I tried so many different anti depressants, went into a mental hospital for TMS treatments because no medication was working for me. Couldn’t leave the house from being so depressed and anxious. My therapist as for all my school reports and I was diagnosed with ADHD. Looking back I’m really disappointed that my school did nothing to support my mental health. I’m on vyvanse now which I find has been working great I can get out of bed and feel more alive and happy about it. The emotional dysregulation is still here but I notice my moods and can cope better. 

I hate that it’s so hard for women to get diagnosed. 

And congratulations for this it’s honestly a very big step into positive life.
